security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Drag a file, shake it, drop it on a tool: free offline PDF tools
bundle.longDescription: PDFportal puts PDF tools one gesture away. Drag any PDF or image, give it a quick shake, and a ring of tools opens under your cursor: compress, merge, split, rotate, convert, number, watermark, protect, unlock. Everything runs on your computer; nothing is uploaded.
